metadata.title: TCS NQT 8-Month Comprehensive Preparation Roadmap
metadata.target: TCS Ninja, Digital & Prime Recruitment (Cognitive + Advanced + Coding + Core CS)

months.title: Month 1 · Foundation
months.desc: Number Systems, Divisibility, Percentages, Ratio, Series, Coding-Decoding, Subject-Verb Agreement, DBMS Architecture & SQL DDL/DML.

months.title: Month 2 · Commercial Math & OS
months.desc: Profit & Loss, SI/CI, Time & Work, Speed-Distance-Time, Syllogisms, Linear/Circular Seating, Error Spotting, OS Processes & CPU Scheduling.

months.title: Month 3 · Modern Math & Networks
months.theme: Modern Math, Analytical Reasoning & Computer Networks
months.desc: Mixtures, Clocks & Calendars, AP/GP, Floor & Box Puzzles, Data Sufficiency, Para Jumbles, Deadlocks, Paging, OSI Layers & IP Subnetting.

months.title: Month 4 · Probability & OOP
months.theme: Combinatorics, Probability, Critical Reasoning & OOP Design
months.desc: Permutations & Combinations, Probability, Statistics, Statement-Assumptions/Conclusions, Reading Comprehension, TCP/IP, OOP & Memory.

months.title: Month 5 · Digital/Prime Math & Advanced SQL
months.desc: 2D/3D Mensuration, Coordinate Geometry, Quadratic Equations, Machine Input-Output, Vocab Roots, Advanced SQL Joins, Subqueries & ACID.

months.title: Month 6 · DI & Software Engineering
months.theme: Advanced Data Interpretation, Logical Deductions & Software Engg
months.desc: Tables, Bar, Line, Pie & Radar Charts, Venn Diagrams, Cubes & Dices, Sentence Completion, SDLC Agile/Scrum, Git & Testing Strategies.

months.title: Month 7 · PYQ Sprints & Coding
months.theme: TCS NQT High-Frequency PYQ Sprints & Digital/Prime Coding Drills
months.desc: 300+ TCS NQT Previous Years' Actual Exam Questions (2020-2026), TCS Coding Assessment Patterns (Strings, Arrays, Hashing, Math) & Linux Shell.

months.title: Month 8 · Proctored Mocks & Interviews
months.theme: Full-Length Proctored Mocks, Speed Optimization & Technical/HR Interview Mastery
months.desc: 10 Full-Length Timed TCS iON Simulated Mocks, Speed Tuning, Technical Interview Project Defense, HR Behavioral STAR Rounds & Final Sign-off.

days.subject: Quant
days.topic: Number Systems & Divisibility Rules
days.desc: Integers, primes, co-primes, prime factorization, divisibility rules for 2 to 19, unit digit cycles (2, 3, 7, 8 power cycles), remainder theorem basics.

days.reasoning: Coding-Decoding: Letter shifting & substitution patterns + 15 MCQs

days.coreCs: Integrity Constraints: Entity, Referential integrity, NOT NULL, UNIQUE, CHECK
